title: The 30-plus-50 capacity plan and the W87-1 first production unit now occupy different registry objects
summary: The registry separates LANL's planned 30-per-year contribution, Savannah River's planned at-least-50 contribution, the enterprise at-least-80 objective, and the one October 2024 fully qualified and diamond-stamped W87-1 first production unit.
